note: M09 development evidence only (D92, D93). The consumption contract is pinned against each producer's main branch: cordanaLLM/imago decodes both Aegis payloads at the commit named here, and cordanaLLM/nucleus is recorded by identity only, because it consumes no Aegis payload. `make contract-fetch` retains `git ls-remote --heads` for both producers, clones imago at this commit into a cache outside the repository and builds it with GOTOOLCHAIN=local CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=true; the gate inside `make verify-all` never touches the network. Nothing is published to either producer from here.

nucleus.role: identity only: publishes the imago.nucleus.kernel-artifact.v1 manifest to imago and reads no Aegis payload (its AGENTS.md, 'The contract with imago'); the kernel result is M10's under D92
